scheme_name: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Death Assistance
other_conditions: Applicant must be ordinarily a worker employed or likely to be employed in any State/Union Territory other than West Bengal or outside India.
Beneficiary must be a nominee nominated by the registered migrant worker from his/her family.
The migrant worker must have died due to natural death or accidental death.
Registered migrant workers must renew their registration annually.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹50,000 for natural death and up to ₹2,00,000 for accidental death.
